reference_transcript: My blood pressure was one hundred and fifty over ninety-five yesterday evening. This morning it was one hundred and forty-two over ninety. I have also had mild headaches during the last week. Have you experienced chest pain, palpitations, fainting, or changes in your vision? No. I have not had any of those symptoms. How long have you had high blood pressure, and what medication are you taking? I was diagnosed about four years ago. I currently take amlodipine five milligrams every morning. Continue taking amlodipine five milligrams once every morning. Do not increase the dose yourself. Please record your blood pressure once in the morning and once in the evening for the next seven days. When should I see you again? Bring those readings to a follow-up appointment in one week. If you develop severe chest pain, fainting, significant shortness of breath, or a very severe headache, seek urgent medical attention rather than waiting for the appointment.
